name: wos-dr
description: Workflow OS disaster recovery snapshots for WOS setup, memory, task/project continuity, and OneDrive-backed restore points.

interface.shortDescription: 🛟 v0.1.2 - compact OneDrive snapshots and recursion guard
interface.longDescription: Workflow OS Disaster Recovery creates OneDrive-backed snapshots of WOS-owned setup state, local memory, task and project receipts, active pointers, plugin versions, and project marker inventories. Project marker scans exclude the configured backup root and use compact snapshot filenames to prevent path-length failures. Restore is explicit and user-confirmed.
defaultPrompt: Set up WOS disaster recovery snapshots.
